$comment: Manifest for the Forgotten Roads for Erenshor release-coordination repo. Individual mod repos remain authoritative for their own source/history; this file only records where to find each one locally and how to build/install it. No source is duplicated here.
_workspaceRootNote: workspaceRoot is the parent of this local collection checkout. Every mod with underMods=true resolves to <workspaceRoot>/<modsSubdir>/<localDir>; a mod with underMods=false (currently only SuiteHub) resolves to <workspaceRoot>/<localDir> directly. Real directories are expected here, not junctions -- SETUP_WORKSPACE.ps1 only clones what's missing, it does not link.
